lines: Round 3 is answered except the motion critic: R1 gave 4. The three look critics gave 6 and 3 and 4. The jury failed it with 4 of 15 votes against a bar of half
Eighteen branch merges since the round froze: the roll of the water. A curling smoke wisp. Thick roof snow. Rail fence. Thick ledge snow and long icicles
Open against the approved image: the glass rim is milky and the water behind it too pale. The streaks are thin needles. The icicles are opaque. The bank is flat
Round 4 freezes at 16:00 UTC on the finished work of the ten finishers
phase 3: 6.28 h used of its 11.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 12.89 h used of 36.00 h allowed
